sources.role: Microsoft design team describes the variable-depth top vents, green subsurface colour and rear tactile interface identifiers
Firsthand original 2020 hardware review explicitly counts the top grid as 12 by 12, 144 holes
Firsthand original hardware measurement reports 10 mm top vent diameter; not a manufacturer tolerance
Firsthand 2020 exterior and teardown, step 2 rear panel and tactile markings
iFixit tactile-dot close-up: 3 dots per USB, 2 Ethernet, 4 storage; broader step 2 photograph also shows power dot and HDMI bar
Manufacturer SD-48405-001 Type-A USB3 drawing and pin assignment: four legacy contacts plus five SuperSpeed contacts; compatible interface reference only
Manufacturer HDMI Type A drawing, pin1/pin19 and pin2/pin18 on opposing tongue faces, 19 contacts total; shell is fitted to existing study aperture, not copied as identified Xbox OEM part
Manufacturer confirms HDMI Type A receptacle with 19 positions
Manufacturer RJ45 reference with eight loaded positions and 1.02 mm pitch; no claim that this CAT5e connector is the Xbox original component
TE customer drawing C2 for the standard eight-contact modular interface
Manufacturer Type A 19-pin receptacle drawing with 15 mm width and 5.65 mm height; used for sleeve height and compatible interface check, not Xbox OEM identity

changes.after: 144 thin display-colour layers following the corrected grid
13 moulded dots plus one HDMI bar, fused into RearPanel

changes.after_layout: 4 legacy plus 5 SuperSpeed; rear tongues aligned with the tall openings
1.02 mm pitch spring contacts and upper carrier
10 + 9 contacts on opposing tongue faces; keyed 15 x 5.65 mm trapezoidal sleeve, 14 x 4.55 mm mating opening and upright HDMI OUT legend

estimated_dimensions.tactile_dot_dimensions: Photographic estimate; moulded caps lie within the nominal outer envelope
estimated_dimensions.port_dimensions: Console port positions and outer apertures retained; local tongue, pin thickness, axial depth and sleeve details fitted to available space

remaining_limitations: No factory dimensional drawing for the original shell or board was verified.
Standard connector references establish contact count and topology, not Xbox OEM part identities.
Storage expansion connector contacts and cable accessory interiors remain schematic.
Controller local curves and electronics remain approximate.
